Excalidraw 0.18.1 (MIT)
Upstream: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw
Release: npm @excalidraw/excalidraw@0.18.1 (lockfile integrity sha512-6i5Gt7IDTOH//qa0Z315Ly5iVRhjWpu2whrlQFqkuwrkKUWgRsMk0P5qdE7bpyDpai7jeLeWYkyj1eVAfni1lw==; the package ships no licence file, so the repo LICENSE at tag v0.18.1 is pinned by SHA-256)
WebPC changes: bundles the npm package with the installed react/react-dom 19.3.1; self-hosts all fonts (webpc-config.js sets EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH to /pc/vendor/excalidraw/ before the bundle loads, and the prep step strips the upstream esm.sh CDN fallback from the bundle's createUrls() so every font src is local-only — no CDN font requests are possible); adds a CSP meta (script-src 'self', worker-src 'self' blob: — the bundled image-blob-reduce helper's data:-URL worker is blocked but has a built-in fallback, third-party connect/frame sources blocked — in-page third-party embeds cannot load); the scene autosaves to the WebPC-namespaced localStorage key pc:excalidraw:scene:v1 and is restored on open. No collaboration props are passed, so the bundled room/collab client (firebase/cloudfunctions URLs in the bundle) is inactive. Excalidraw+ / library / share links are user-click new-tab links only. See docs/webpc/excalidraw.md.
